verdict.rationale: Khoj has a dedicated telemetry docs page saying users can opt out at any time by setting the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable to True. Self-hosting also lets users keep their data on their own device. One community commenter complained there was no clear, documented opt-out for the PostHog telemetry, but that is a question rather than a concrete failure, and the docs now document one. missing for 10: details on what usage data is collected and how the opt-out is scoped, any opt-out path for Khoj Cloud (non-self-hosted) users, independent or hands-on confirmation that the env var stops tracking.
